utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, I’m a bit slammed—quick version, are you handling a drop-off or do you need supplies from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and tool list, so I’m not set on drop-off yet. If you can, just hold off on supplies for now and I’ll pass along the exact needs once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll hold off for now. Just send me the time and tool list when you’ve got it, and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m checking who can still help and what tools or supplies we should line up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center should be okay for me, and I’ll check with the other parents about who can still help. Let me know what tools or supplies you need lined up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Faye — if you could ask about basic sewing kits, small hand tools, extension cords, and a couple of folding tables, that would help me see what gaps we still have.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Sam, yes—the repair drive. I’m checking with a couple parents about whether after pickup, around 3:30 to 5, really works before I start digging out supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — I’m still set for Saturday morning with my drill and hammer, and I’ll keep an eye out for screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set while you confirm the 3:30 to 5 window.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — Saturday morning with your drill and hammer is perfect, and I’ll let you know once I’ve checked with those parents about the 3:30 to 5 window.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah! I’m just nailing down the priority repairs, signup count, and tool list so I can connect folks to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I’m a little fuzzy on the details, but I can double-check the priority repairs and tool list before I pass anything along. If you need a hand sorting donations too, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Noah — if you can double-check the priority repairs and tool list, I’ll handle the signup count and then we can sort donations around what’s actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Ira, we’ve got Noah sorting donations and Rey checking for screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures, so I’m comparing that against the sign-up sheet now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara — I’ll let folks know Noah’s on donations and Rey’s checking tools, and I’ll mention Gus can lend a hand and a few extras if you’re short.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — please send Gus my way after Rey reports back, and I’ll plug him in wherever the tool table is still short.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m rallying neighbors for the repair drive this weekend—if you’re free, we’d love to have you swing by and lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in. I’ll bring the basic tool list and help set up the repair table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic, Leo — that’ll be a huge help. I’ll spread the word that you’ve got the repair table covered and keep you posted once I confirm the final details!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Uli — I’m setting up the donation table now, and after that I can help with tools if there’s still a need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — a few tools and extra hands would be really helpful, especially for the lamps and small appliances. I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll finish the donation table and be ready for the tools when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Nell, I’m still piecing it together, but it sounds like they’re aiming for Saturday morning at the community room. If you can bring screwdrivers, pliers, or a socket set, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ll hold off on spreading that until Rosa confirms it, but I can set aside some screwdrivers and pliers just in case.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell — that sounds perfect. I’ll check with Rosa and let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — did you hear back yet about the time, drop-off spot, and who’s coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still pinning down the time and drop-off spot, but I’m coordinating it. I’ll share the details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — once you’ve got the time and drop-off spot, should I keep sorting parts in the community room for now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Hana. I’ve only heard they’re aiming for Saturday morning in the community room, but I’d still check the bulletin or organizer for the exact plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check the bulletin, and can you confirm what kinds of repairs they want brought in? I want to make sure I have the time and items right before helping.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can’t confirm for certain yet, Hana, but Tess mentioned folks are asking about small fixes and tools like screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set. Best to check the bulletin or organizer so you have the exact repair list and time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll gather my basic tools and come ready to sort whatever still needs organizing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey—thanks. I’ll keep a cleared spot for your tools and point you toward the unsorted supplies when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — I’ll bring the tools and help sort the unsorted supplies when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the school gym after pickup Friday and the church basement Saturday morning as partial notes—have you heard any confirmed times or who’s covering drop-offs?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not confirmed yet — Pia and Ira both said they’d verify the time, location, and coordinator before we share anything. Can you hold off on telling folks until one of them confirms it directly?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll hold off and wait for Pia or Ira to confirm the time, location, and coordinator directly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m starting with screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures like Mara asked, then I’ll check with Cleo on supplies so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll pass along that screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are covered, and I’ll wait on the final time and supplies from the organizer before I share anything wider.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep checking with Cleo and Mara on what’s still missing, and I’ll wait for the organizer before anything goes wider.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, quick version—I’m slammed, but I can bring a screwdriver set, work gloves, and spare tape or screws if that helps Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great, Bo—those supplies will help a lot. I’m setting up the donation table first, so just drop them there Saturday when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll drop them at the donation table Saturday when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Noah, just to confirm — have you heard anything definite about the repair drive time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Not definite yet, sorry — I’m still double-checking the time and drop-off spot so I don’t pass along the wrong info.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Noah — can you let me know as soon as you confirm? I’d rather hold off telling people until we have the exact time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m going to confirm the drop-off time, location, and coordinator before we share anything, just so nobody gets sent to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia — just let me know once it’s confirmed, and I’ll keep track of the location and timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Will do — I’ll verify the details and send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’m checking the bulletin when I get back inside and I’ll spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you spreading the word. Let me know if you see any update on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Sam — I’ll check the bulletin as soon as I’m back inside, and if there’s any update I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa, I’m going through the repair drive supplies now—Oren may cover screws, tape, and an extension cord, and Rey’s bringing basic tools, so I’m checking what gaps are left.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s really helpful. Keep me posted on any gaps you spot, and I’ll help fill them before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Rosa — I’ll check the list and let you know what we’re still short on before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Quinn, before I jump in, can you confirm what exactly needs repairing and when Rosa has the drive scheduled?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still confirming Rosa’s exact schedule and repair list, but I’ll get those details and send them over right away. If it lines up, I’d love to have you join us!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for Rosa’s schedule and the repair list before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it second-hand so far, so I’m waiting on the confirmed details before I pass anything along. Once I get them, I’ll be happy to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that’s sensible. Once we’ve got the time and spot pinned down, I’ll pass it along so you can share it around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks Gus — once you or Rosa send the confirmed time and spot, I’ll help pass it along on my end of the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli — I’m helping pin down the priority repairs and match volunteers to supplies; do you know what tools or time you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can be there Saturday morning if that’s still the plan, Jules, and I’ll bring my screwdrivers and pliers. I’d like to confirm the time on the bulletin first so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — Saturday morning is still the plan, and I’ll check the bulletin to confirm it. Your screwdrivers and pliers are perfect, thanks for jumping in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday morning in the community room? Sam’s bringing a drill and hammer, and Oren’s hunting down screws and tape, but we’re still looking for screwdrivers, pliers, or a socket set if you’ve got any.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ve got a screwdriver set and some pliers. I’ll bring them Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Leo — thank you! Bring them Saturday morning to the community room, and we’ll put them to good use.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, I’m holding Friday in the school gym for right after pickup, around 3:30 to 5—did the other parents you checked with think that window works?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that window seems to work for them too—3:30 to 5 after pickup should be fine. I’ll bring the screws, tape, and I’m still trying to find that extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep Friday right after pickup, 3:30 to 5, set for the school gym and bring the sign-up sheet. Let me know if you track down the extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we still need to sort the donations and check the tool table. If you can help with either, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can sort donations first. Where do you want me to set up, and should I separate parts by type or condition?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Set up by the folding tables near the entrance, and please separate by type first, then set aside anything damaged or missing parts.
